name: wsgi.py
summary: Django WSGI application entry point for the conversationalBI project
purpose: This file configures the Web Server Gateway Interface (WSGI) bridge between a WSGI-compliant web server and the conversationalBI Django application. It exists to standardize production deployment by exposing a module-level callable that HTTP servers (e.g., Gunicorn, uWSGI, Apache mod_wsgi) can invoke to forward requests into Django and return HTTP responses.
responsibilities: Set the DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE environment variable to point to the correct Django settings
Import and initialize the Django WSGI application handler via get_wsgi_application()
Expose the WSGI callable as the module-level variable named application
Act as the boundary layer between the web server and the Django framework
outputs: WSGI application callable (module-level variable named application)
architecture_notes: This is the standard Django WSGI bootstrap configuration following Django's convention-over-configuration deployment pattern. It serves as the production application server entry point, implementing the WSGI protocol bridge to decouple the web server from the application framework. The file uses environment-variable-driven configuration to allow the same codebase to target different settings modules (e.g., production, staging) without code changes, supporting the 12-Factor App methodology. It should remain thin and free of business logic to ensure stable, predictable server startup behavior.
improvements: Add explicit validation and a descriptive error message if DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE is not set before application initialization
Wrap get_wsgi_application() in a try-except block with structured logging to capture and diagnose startup failures in production
Add type hints (e.g., from django.core.handlers.wsgi import WSGIHandler) to improve developer experience and static analysis
Document or optionally integrate a production-grade static file server (e.g., WhiteNoise) if applicable to the deployment topology
Consider adding an application wrapper for APM/monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, Datadog) with conditional activation via environment variables
